title: Prescriptions Schedule of Repeat Amounts on Controlled Short Fills
content:
A Kestrel Prescriptions record in the Schedule V Controlled Prescription, Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription or Schedule II Controlled Prescription class that has been dispensed short more than once earns the controlled repeat amount when its owed balance is declined.

## Schedule

The controlled repeat amount counts the owed-balance entries booked on the prescription in the last 12 months:

| Owed-balance entries in the last 12 months | Amount added to the controlled decline credit |
|---|---|
| three or more | 2.00 |
| exactly two | 1.00 |
| one | nothing |

## Readings (hypothetical)

- The declined entry and one earlier entry 6 months ago: two, so 1.00 is added.
- The declined entry and two earlier entries this year: three, so 2.00 is added.
- The declined entry and one entry 15 months ago: one within the last 12 months, so nothing is added.
